summary: 2026-27 home kit, per the club's launch photos and the kit designer's case: Magnit on the front, Wildberries right chest, Betcity on the lower front, the back and the shorts, Mever on a sleeve. The other sleeve carries the RPL league patch; the crowd-of-people chest motif is part of the Dagestan-flag kit design, not a sponsor.
